record.paper_title: Open Problems on Syzygies and Hilbert Functions
record.original_question: Construct a well-structured nonminimal free resolution, at least in special cases, of the Orlik-Solomon algebra A over the exterior algebra E.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $K$ be a field and let $E = \bigwedge\langle e_1, \dots, e_n\rangle$ be the exterior algebra on $n$ generators over $K$, regarded as a graded skew-commutative $K$-algebra. Let $\mathcal{A} = \{H_1, \dots, H_n\}$ be a (central) hyperplane arrangement in a finite-dimensional vector space, with intersection lattice $L(\mathcal{A})$ and underlying matroid $M$. The Orlik–Solomon ideal $J(\mathcal{A}) \subseteq E$ is the ideal generated by the elements
$$\partial e_S \;=\; \sum_{k=1}^{r}(-1)^{k-1} e_{i_1}\wedge\cdots\wedge \widehat{e_{i_k}}\wedge\cdots\wedge e_{i_r}$$
for every dependent subset (circuit) $S = \{i_1 < \cdots < i_r\}$ of $M$, and the Orlik–Solomon algebra is
$$A(\mathcal{A}) \;=\; E / J(\mathcal{A}).$$
Construct, at least for distinguished classes of arrangements (for example: generic arrangements, graphic/supersolvable arrangements, arrangements whose Orlik–Solomon ideal admits a linear resolution, or other tractable families), an explicit, well-structured (not necessarily minimal) graded free resolution of $A(\mathcal{A})$ as a left $E$-module. The resolution should be described combinatorially in terms of $L(\mathcal{A})$ (or of $M$), with explicit differentials, and should be amenable to the computation of homological invariants of $A(\mathcal{A})$ over $E$.
artifact.status_search_result: The literature contains results on minimal linear (injective and projective) resolutions of Orlik–Solomon algebras over the exterior algebra, computations of Betti numbers, complexity, depth and regularity in special cases (e.g., matroids with linear OS-ideal). However, no source clearly establishes a general well-structured nonminimal free resolution program addressing this problem in full; the construction of explicit nonminimal resolutions in special cases appears to remain a guiding open direction rather than a settled theorem.

status_evidence.title: Homological properties of Orlik-Solomon algebras
status_evidence.snippet: Studies complexity, depth and regularity of Orlik–Solomon algebras over the exterior algebra and characterizes matroids with linear projective resolution.
status_evidence.claim: Linear (minimal) resolutions are known in special cases, but a general nonminimal structured resolution is not provided.

status_evidence.title: Hyperplane Arrangement Cohomology and Monomials in the Exterior Algebra
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses the OS algebra as a quotient of the exterior algebra and its homological behavior.
status_evidence.claim: Background on OS-algebra resolutions over E.
